description: This file implements the `timezoneJS.Date` class, providing enhanced timezone-aware date functionality that extends the native JavaScript Date object. It includes timezone support, JSON serialization, custom formatting, and timezone data handling. The code integrates with external transport libraries (like jQuery, Zepto, or fleegix) for zone data loading and manages timezone information for accurate date and time operations across different regions.

classes.name: timezoneJS.Date
classes.description: A constructor function that creates timezone-aware Date objects with support for various input formats, timezone setting, and serialization.

methods.name: getTimezoneInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone offset and abbreviation based on the current timezone and cached data.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone of the date object to a specified timezone ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats the date into a string based on a specified format and timezone, supporting custom tokens for date and time components.
